```{r}
## Part B — Basic Data Types
## 01 typeof
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number

typeof(x)
typeof(y)
typeof(z)
typeof(w)
typeof(v)
```
```{r}
## 02 class
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number

class(x)
class(y)
class(z)
class(w)
class(v)
```
```{r}
## 03 mode
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number

mode(x)
mode(y)
mode(z)
mode(w)
mode(v)
```
```{r}
## Question 3
x <- 42
y <- 42L

typeof(x)
typeof(y)

## typeof(x) has an ouput of double because R default 42 as a floating number type(y) is a integer because of the L sufftix that force integer storage.
```
